lines.en: Four short legs work the riverbed.
My body skims low over the sand.
Long snout ahead, me behind.
I work the shallows by the bank.
One sweep of the tail and I'm forward.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头上滑下来。
lines.en: I slide down off a rock.
The pebbles slip under my feet.
I walk the base of the butte.

lines.zh: 干旱的林子也是有水的。
lines.en: Even dry forests have water.
I dive under, then surface.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛刚好露出水面。
lines.en: Only my eyes break the surface.
I circle the shallow bar.
I keep to the bank's shadow.
My movement barely stirs water.
My long snout rests on a stone.
My eyes never leave the water.
A waterbird landed far off.

lines.zh: 我在这里守着自己的水。
lines.en: I keep this water as mine.
My teeth line up in a row.
This river is my territory.
I swallow a mouthful of water.
My tail sways slowly.

lines.zh: 岸上很安静，水里也安静。
lines.en: The bank is quiet. So is the water.
Waiting for prey to come close.

lines.zh: 这片河岸归我，小鱼也是。
lines.en: This riverbank is mine, and its fish.
Damp evaporates off my back, cold.
I've warmed the stone I lie on.
You're standing on my bank.
All of this water is mine.
You scared off the waterbirds.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人靠近水边。
lines.en: I dislike anyone at my water's edge.

lines.zh: 你走得很小心，我看见了。
lines.en: You walk carefully. I noticed.
Here to drink, are you?
This river is shallow and narrow.
Two steps back would be wise.
My teeth are small, but many.
I've had my eyes on you a while.
They hit my tail.

lines.zh: 凯恩塔鳄的短腿，一步步退回水中。
lines.en: The little croc's short legs back into the water.
My snout cracked against stone.
Blood flows into the river.
I rolled and righted myself.
The water absorbs some of it.
I lie still on the riverbed.
Small as I am, my temper is anything but.
That doesn't look like a fish.
Put it in the water. I'll get it.
I want it alive and swimming.
Your hand's too near the water.
Only fish blood smells right.
Drop it and look away.
I don't eat things off the land.
This river has plenty of fish.
You stepped into my water.
My snout met your boot.
Back off. It's narrow here.
I'm not a stone. Don't step.
You pushed me off the bank.
My tail swung into you.
I sank to the bed to let you pass.
That splashed a lot of water.
Don't kick at the water's surface.
Push in more and you'll be on my back.
I only speak of that in the water.

lines.zh: 我的领地比你想象的大。
lines.en: My territory is larger than you think.
That's not for me to answer.
Let me eat my fill of fish first.
The bank doesn't concern me.
That waits for the right water level.
I say nothing.
I slipped down underwater.
Go on. Don't linger.
That isn't mine to think about.
I shovel it up with my snout.
This thing is very slippery.
Fish? It smells like one.
I swallowed it in one go.
I drag this stone aside.
This can line my nest edge.
This wasn't yours, was it.

lines.zh: 这块鱼肉，我藏进卵石底下。
lines.en: This bit of fish goes under the river stones.
Something moved in the water.
Its shadow reached the bank first.
I've marked this stretch of water.
Is it coming down to the water?
I sink down to the bottom first.
One lunge covers this gap.
I can see its feet.
I shifted a little upstream.
Its shadow lies on the weeds.
I wait for it to crouch.
My tail is drawn in.
Only my eyes show above water.
It's very close to me now.
This one will be quick.
It's standing still on the bank.
I'm easing toward the bank.
The water covers my movement.
It's looking down into the water.
I've sunk to just my eyes.
It stepped back, then forward.
My long snout goes out first.
Just one more bend from it.
The riverbed is soft and slick.
Its foot is right above me.
I've waited a long while for this.
Stay. Don't retreat again.
The surface is calm. I'm invisible.
I've buried myself in the mud.
Once I bite, I don't let go.
I snap at your ankle.
I lunge with my whole body.
My snout sweeps and you stumble.
This one comes with a splash.
My teeth are many. You can't shake free.
I'm dragging you into the water.
You kicked back at me.
I rolled over and came back.
The splash covered my eyes.
I let go. Go on, run.
I only bit into sand.
I withdraw to deeper water.

lines.zh: 我的牙嵌在你的护腿上。
lines.en: My teeth are in your greave.
One more bite and I'm gone.
I come up out of the river mud.
There's a small pool below the butte.
I lie at the bank, perfectly still.
Even dry forests have rivers.
I tested the water's warmth.
My long snout rests on stone.
My drag marks show in the sand.
The water's shallow but enough to hide in.
I draw my tail into the water.
Quiet except for the water.

lines.zh: 我从河底的沙里探出长吻。
lines.en: My long snout rises out of the riverbed sand.
This water has no master yet.
I sink down to observe.

lines.zh: 岸上有我没有闻过的味道。
lines.en: There's a new smell on the bank.
I lie lower than the stones.
River mud coats my body.
I begin patrolling my stretch.
The weeds hide half of me.

lines.zh: 岸上的火烤干了我背上的水。
lines.en: Fire on the bank dried my back.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔进浅水，磕了牙。
lines.en: I fell into the shallows and jarred my teeth.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我一时辨不清方向。
lines.en: Water rushed in and I lost my bearings.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水和泥一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast threw up water and mud.
An arrow stuck in my back plate.
That light shattered across the water.

lines.zh: 河里没鱼了，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: No fish in this river. I'm frantic.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我喘不上来。
lines.en: No water here. I can't breathe.
